question: As announced in the Budget 2022, the corporate surcharge was reduced from 12% to ________.
solution:
The correct answer is__** 0.07.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **corporate surcharge** is a tax levied on the** income of companies, **which is in addition to the regular income tax.
 
• The reduction in the corporate surcharge from **12% to 0.07%** was announced in the** Union Budget 2022-23**, which was presented by the Finance Minister.
